The floor is large-format light stone or concrete tile. Warm amber light glows downward onto the tabletop from sources above, creating a focused pool of candlelit warmth that contrasts with the cool blue dusk air beyond. The palette is warm weathered wood, dark natural wicker, cream, sandy stone, and deep blue-green evening sky.
